properties.notes: The site can support 54 units (a mixture of 2,3,4+ bedroom houses and 1 bedroom flats), as outlined in lapsed planning permission. A planning application has been received for a non-residential development scheme for this site (ERE/1018/0038) which was refused by Committee, however the Council are still supportive of residential development at this site. The Council's refusal of the scheme was appealed and the Appeal process took place in December 2020, with the outcome still pending. This site is in the SHLAA2019 Ref 333.
